title: Myth: a generator is enough backup for cameras and networks

scenes.headline: A generator is enough backup for cameras and networks.
scenes.voice: Many organisations believe a generator is all the backup their cameras and networks will ever need.

scenes.headline: Generators start late, need fuel, and fail unnoticed.
lines: Fuel must reach the site in time
A missed service shows up on the worst day
scenes.voice: In reality, a generator takes time to start, and sensitive equipment drops in that gap. It depends on fuel reaching the site, and a missed service only shows up on the worst possible day.

scenes.headline: Protect the systems that record and alert.
scenes.voice: Critical security and network equipment needs a UPS that carries it through the first seconds and minutes, sized to each cabinet's real load and tested with your team, with the generator as the last layer.

scenes.headline: Request an executive briefing
scenes.voice: FOG Technologies Nexus designs UPS backup for critical security and network systems. Request an executive briefing at CEO at fogtechnexus.space.
